import json
from pathlib import Path
from inference import predict_with_details,load_symptom_alias_map,load_symptom_name_map
from labels import load_disease_name_map
model=json.loads(Path('models/symptom_disease_41_nb.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
cases=['cough','high_fever','cough;headache;nausea']
print(json.dumps([predict_with_details(model,x,disease_name_map=load_disease_name_map(),symptom_alias_map=load_symptom_alias_map(),symptom_name_map=load_symptom_name_map(),top_k=5) for x in cases],ensure_ascii=True))
